title: Reduce complete member-bank census time by 9.78% (no κ)
body:
## Summary

A bounded cache reduces the complete PR6396 independent member-bank census command from a local median 4.2855 s to 3.8666 s, **9.78%**, across five alternating fresh-process pairs. Every pair improves. Claim type: scoped implementation-equivalence proof, exact finite conformance and a local performance observation. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

```text
contains(outer, inner)
  look up the complete ordered immutable space pair
  return its previously computed Boolean when present
  otherwise evaluate the unchanged exact predicate
  retain the result while the bounded table has room
```

Only `research/g20-member-bank-cache/` is added. The seventeen required source files from ToikY's PR6396 at `2a5bc94df6d741b49afbadd36d96eb2aea0f6f1f` are retained byte-for-byte, including notices. The private adapter changes one pure function binding. The census class, complete domain, direct checks, scientific receipt and receipt comparison stay unchanged. The source's mathematics is a cited premise, not an audit deliverable.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the source profile spends 3.363 of 12.013 profiled seconds in rational containment. The unprofiled complete command ranges from 4.1155 to 4.8022 s.
  **After:** the cache avoids 11,194 of 14,788 exact predicate evaluations and holds 3,594 of its allowed 32,768 entries. The complete command ranges from 3.6853 to 4.1152 s. All ten timed processes have the exact source success output, empty stderr and zero exit status. The timer includes startup, all current census work, input checks, complete receipt comparison, output capture and exit. These shared-host macOS observations do not establish cross-host performance.
- Normal and optimized warning-strict replay pass 432 directional containment comparisons, capacity-exhaustion cases and six rejecting controls. Both reconstruct the complete scientific object with digest `b3efbc891a7bd4b0303d61bcdf39bcffe1f3e951e0bd2dfed5ea2c24bbac92f4`.
- Two Git-free, empty-PATH, read-only CLI replays preserve their input inventories. Three actual CLI controls reject changed frozen bytes, a changed manifest and omitted cache installation. Both wrong-result in-process implementation mutants reject.
- Local registered replay passes. The three individual checks took 3.835 s, 3.570 s and 11.051 s, below their 120/120/180-second limits. Warning-strict compilation passes. Committed bytes, executable modes and declared source ancestry pass for all thirty package files. All seventeen staged source blobs and modes equal the public source tree, including preserved CRLF bytes.
- Official package export and input coverage checks pass. The committed export also passes a Git-free read-only scientific replay. `BENCHMARK.json` binds the measured code and includes every pair; `PROFILE.json` is a separate profiled run. The new verifier emits its own hash-bound receipt.

Exact reproduction from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/g20-member-bank-cache/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/g20-member-bank-cache/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/g20-member-bank-cache/test_controls.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/g20-member-bank-cache
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/g20-member-bank-cache --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Use an existing CPython 3.12 path elsewhere. Put temporary outputs outside the checkout with `TMPDIR` when appropriate. `replay.py` runs the faster complete caller; `benchmark.py --pairs 5` emits a fresh timing receipt to stdout. The expected registered marker is `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

## Limitations

Equivalence assumes the pinned caller's immutable canonical rational spaces and pure containment predicate. Cache exhaustion falls back to the original function. This changes no default source implementation, physical word, target, paid invoice, native operation, owned erasure, compiler or ordinary/outer admission. All five framework assumptions remain.

The other PR6396 registered commands, the selected supplier cold replay, Lean and Docker are outside this cost result and were not run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. The written proof records bounded allocation and fixed dynamic-loading deviations. The pending source is retained in this committed export; its public origin is bound in `FROZEN.json`. The generic ancestry check separately covers the declared main-branch provenance pins.

## Open next questions

Should a future version of the original census adopt this bounded cache? Start from one exact new source head and its immutable-input/pure-predicate contract, then preserve its complete receipt and failure controls. Changed source contracts and adoption are outside this isolated result. Further optimization is unreserved.

## Related open work

- #6396 supplies the exact census, oracle, source and mathematical coverage contract used here. This PR improves one complete command's execution cost and preserves its scientific object; it supplies no new audit or rank category.
- #6389 studies a later G20 triple-capture model. It changes neither this cache nor this member-bank census contract. No extra computation was run to check its result.
- #6415 improves the complete literal header census of PR4345 with low-rank conjugation. Its caller, arithmetic kernel and numerical quantities differ from this G20 containment cache; no extra computation checked its result.

The completion refresh inspected eleven other account open PRs created since the advance CLAIM. No newly found PR studies this same member-bank census or containment-cache quantity, and no same-instance numerical disagreement was identified within that coverage.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks, `plan` and `replay (research/g20-member-bank-cache)`, passed at head `7bc62998ba3fc9f15f6f455d41d923d1ca3945be` in [run 41529262678](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41529262678). The completed checks were read once; run metadata confirms successful completion and the matching commit. All declared checks also passed locally. Hosted replay covers the registered finite checks and source bindings. It does not certify the local timing percentage or independent scientific acceptance. The benchmark has no registered CI timing assertion.
